verdict.rationale: Phoenix explicitly supports grouping traces into datasets, rerunning them through different versions of an app, and comparing evaluation results to confirm whether a change improved or regressed performance, with evals designed to 'understand whether an update is an improvement or a regression' and 'compare specific examples vs. prior runs.' Experiments compare changes on the same inputs, and evaluators automatically score outputs for side-by-side comparison across runs. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of a dedicated side-by-side UI comparison view or third-party validation of this workflow.
